issues: Document type differs from standard product-testing 'Область аккредитации' scope: this is a metrological verification (поверка средств измерений) scope with columns № | Измерения, тип (группа) средств измерений | Тип (группа) средств измерений | диапазон измерений | погрешность и (или) неопределенность | Примечание — there is no норм.документ, ОКПД2 or ТН ВЭД column, so norm_doc/okpd2_code/tnved_code are null on every row. 'indicator' was mapped from column 2 (measurement category) and 'object' from column 3 (instrument type); the погрешность/неопределенность column is not represented in the schema and is omitted (only present in raw_row_text where a specific sub-label like влажность/давление/DN/Δt was shown alongside a range). No ТР ТС section headings exist in this document, so tr_section is null throughout; the full-width address lines (two lab locations) were treated as location separators, not tr_section headings, per the rules. Row №10's 'диапазон измерений' cell is prose describing verification methodology rather than a numeric range, so it was kept as free text in range_from with range_to/unit null. No rotated or illegible pages; both pages rendered clean at 150dpi and were fully legible.
